item.coloph: ces mkha' klong gsang ba'i mdos chen 'di/ nyams chags bskangs dang glud du 'bul/ bzlog pa'i las dang bsad pa'o/ dang po gshen rab nyid kyis mdzad/ bar du gdung rabs rim gyis brgyud/ gshen rab bar chod nyams chags bsal/ tha mar len gcig nub pa'i tshe/ hris pa'i smon lam mthu brtsan pa'i/ bon la mos shing dam tshig che/ theg dgu'i sgor zhugs bsgrab la brtson/ kha dam khong drangs sems dkar ba'i/ ltag nyan thol smra dus dus byed/ de lta bu'i (bus) spel bar 'gyur/ gsang bon 'di spyod gshen rab kun/ nyams chags bskang zhing 'gal 'khrul zhi/ bar chod sel zhing rkyen rnams bzlog ye shes lha yi thugs rjes 'dzin/ phyi mar bde 'gro'i gnas su 'khod/ ces gsungs so//
